procedural_matters: ITA 311 was represented by Bruno Festo (Crew)
USA 118 was represented by Duncan Williford (Crew)
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: 40 seconds before the starting signal of race Q2, both boats were holding position on starboard tack with USA 118 clear ahead and 20 metres to leeward.
USA 118 tacked to port and continued on port for 5 seconds.
When ITA 311 was approximately 1 boat length from the bow of USA 118, ITA 311 luffed to pass head to wind and on to port tack.
USA 118 sailing faster bore away over the bow of ITA 311.
As she did so, ITA 311 passed head to wind back on to starboard, bore away, and passed behind USA 118.
conclusions: USA 118 kept clear of ITA 311 and did not break rule 10.
ITA 311 gave room to USA 118 whilst changing course and did not break rule 16.1
